lines: Would be so as of others doubt not in mind should shine; having washed then bathing with flower then should worship.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhavettathā yathānyeṣāṃ śaṅkā no manasi sphuret mārjayitvā tataḥ snānaṃ puṣpeṇātha prapūjayet
